keyPoints.en: General form: ax² + bx + c = 0, a ≠ 0. Rearrange to '= 0' before solving.
keyPoints.bm: Bentuk am: ax² + bx + c = 0, a ≠ 0. Susun semula kepada '= 0' sebelum menyelesaikan.

keyPoints.en: Solve by factorisation, completing the square, or the formula x = [−b ± √(b² − 4ac)]/2a.
keyPoints.bm: Selesaikan dengan pemfaktoran, penyempurnaan kuasa dua, atau rumus x = [−b ± √(b² − 4ac)]/2a.

keyPoints.en: Forming an equation from roots α and β: x² − (α + β)x + αβ = 0.
keyPoints.bm: Membentuk persamaan daripada punca α dan β: x² − (α + β)x + αβ = 0.

keyPoints.en: Sum of roots = −b/a, product of roots = c/a.
keyPoints.bm: Hasil tambah punca = −b/a, hasil darab punca = c/a.

keyPoints.en: Quadratic inequalities: find the roots, sketch the graph, read where it is above (> 0) or below (< 0) the x-axis.
keyPoints.bm: Ketaksamaan kuadratik: cari punca, lakar graf, baca di mana graf di atas (> 0) atau di bawah (< 0) paksi-x.

tip.en: 'Between' answers (−2 < x < 4) come from < 0 with a > 0; 'outside' answers from > 0.
tip.bm: Jawapan 'di antara' (−2 < x < 4) datang dari < 0 dengan a > 0; jawapan 'di luar' dari > 0.

keyPoints.en: Discriminant D = b² − 4ac decides the type of roots.
keyPoints.bm: Pembeza layan D = b² − 4ac menentukan jenis punca.

keyPoints.en: D > 0: two distinct real roots (graph cuts the x-axis twice).
keyPoints.bm: D > 0: dua punca nyata berbeza (graf memotong paksi-x dua kali).

keyPoints.en: D = 0: two equal real roots (graph touches the x-axis). D < 0: no real roots (graph doesn't meet the x-axis).
keyPoints.bm: D = 0: dua punca nyata sama (graf menyentuh paksi-x). D < 0: tiada punca nyata (graf tidak bertemu paksi-x).

keyPoints.en: 'Real roots' means D ≥ 0. Use these conditions to find unknown constants (e.g. k).
keyPoints.bm: 'Punca nyata' bermakna D ≥ 0. Guna syarat ini untuk mencari pemalar yang tidak diketahui (cth. k).

question.en: Find the range of k if x² + 4x + k = 0 has no real roots.
question.bm: Cari julat k jika x² + 4x + k = 0 tiada punca nyata.

tip.en: When a line is tangent to a curve, substitute and set D = 0.
tip.bm: Apabila garis ialah tangen kepada lengkung, gantikan dan tetapkan D = 0.

keyPoints.en: f(x) = ax² + bx + c: a > 0 gives ∪ (minimum), a < 0 gives ∩ (maximum).
keyPoints.bm: f(x) = ax² + bx + c: a > 0 memberi ∪ (minimum), a < 0 memberi ∩ (maksimum).

keyPoints.en: Vertex form f(x) = a(x − h)² + k: turning point (h, k), axis of symmetry x = h.
keyPoints.bm: Bentuk verteks f(x) = a(x − h)² + k: titik pusingan (h, k), paksi simetri x = h.

keyPoints.en: Effects: changing a → width/shape; changing b → shifts the axis; changing c → shifts up/down (y-intercept).
keyPoints.bm: Kesan: ubah a → lebar/bentuk; ubah b → anjak paksi; ubah c → anjak ke atas/bawah (pintasan-y).

keyPoints.en: Sketch: shape, y-intercept, x-intercepts, turning point, axis of symmetry.
keyPoints.bm: Lakaran: bentuk, pintasan-y, pintasan-x, titik pusingan, paksi simetri.

keyPoints.en: Applications: maximum height of a projectile, maximum area or profit.
keyPoints.bm: Aplikasi: ketinggian maksimum projektil, luas atau keuntungan maksimum.

question.en: A farmer fences a rectangle against a wall using 40 m of fence (3 sides). Find the maximum area.
question.bm: Seorang petani memagar segi empat tepat bersandar dinding menggunakan 40 m pagar (3 sisi). Cari luas maksimum.

answer.en: A = x(40 − 2x) = −2(x − 10)² + 200 → maximum 200 m² when x = 10 m.
answer.bm: L = x(40 − 2x) = −2(x − 10)² + 200 → maksimum 200 m² apabila x = 10 m.

tip.en: Try the Quadratic graph plotter tool to see how a, b and c change the graph.
tip.bm: Cuba alat Pemplot graf kuadratik untuk melihat kesan a, b dan c pada graf.
